text: Where Did My Tokens Go?（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：在会话运行时展示输入和输出 token 计数。它订阅当前会话事件，并把计数徽标放在深度思考指示器旁，也为完成的操作行标注各步用量。主要功能包括实时估算与结算用量校准、合并或分开展示、缓存命中与未命中细分，以及按站点调整单位和样式。适合想在对话过程中查看提示词及生成内容用量的 DSH 用户。需要可运行的 DSH 网页客户端，无需额外密钥。

Where Did My Tokens Go? adds live token counts to DSH web conversations and usage totals to completed operation steps. Counts update from settled usage after streaming. Users can choose merged or split display, cache breakdowns, and per-site units and styles. It needs a working DSH web client.
想在 DSH 对话里实时看到输入和输出 token 数。
有没有办法查看每个已完成操作分别用了多少 token？
让网页会话把 token 统计显示在思考状态旁边。
我想把输入和输出用量分开同时展示。
怎样查看提示词缓存命中和未命中的 token 数？
希望大数字自动缩写成 K、M 这样的单位。
Show me live input and output token counts while I chat.
I want to see token usage for each completed operation.
Where Did My Tokens Go? 的功能「实时输入与输出计数」：插件在思考和生成期间更新计数徽标，按字符估算输出，并在用量事件到达后校准为实际值；输入计数包含缓存读写用量。
Where Did My Tokens Go? 的功能「逐步操作用量」：每条已完成操作行显示其对应步骤的 token 用量；结算事件按 turn 和 step 记录，重复结算会更新原步骤数据。
Where Did My Tokens Go? 的功能「计数显示与样式设置」：用户可切换合并或分开展示，分别启用输入、输出和操作用量，并按站点设置单位、字体大小和颜色。
Where Did My Tokens Go? 的功能「操作缓存细分」：可单独开启每步用量中的未命中和命中缓存数字，显示提示词缓存两部分的用量。

This README describes **1.9.3**.

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Features：Put "where did this turn's tokens go" directly in the transcript: a live counter rides the deep-thinking indicator, and every finished operation row is tagged with the cost of its own step. The plugin is global — once installed, every conversation gets it.

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Features：- **Live in / out badge**: after the blue 「深度思考 / 深度求索」 ("deep-thinking") indicator, a shimmer-swept badge counts tokens while the model is thinking and streaming. The sweep reuses the platform's own TextShimmer geometry, so the badge reads as part of the same sentence.
  - `in N` = input tokens, `out N` = output tokens, reasoning text included.
  - **Both figures price the whole exchange, prompt cache included.** The provider's own `inputTokens` covers only the *uncached* part of the prompt (the API subtracts cache reads and writes before reporting it), while a warm cache makes that part tiny — measured on a real transcript, cache hits were 99% of the prompt, so a 25K-token prompt reported 628 fresh tokens. The plugin therefore adds `cacheReadTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` back onto the settled figure, keeping it on the same full-prompt scale as the harness's live projection (`contextPressure`). That projection prices the **next** request and is live during the input phase; the usage of the request just finished outranks it, and before either exists the last known full prompt is reused. Output counts are estimated client-side while stream

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Usage：| What you want | How |
| --- | --- |
| Watch this turn's in / out tokens | Send a message and read the badge after the 「深度思考」 indicator; it counts in real time. |
| Switch merged / split | Open **Settings → Token 计数器** and click the matching preview card. |
| Keep only in or only out | Toggle the other switch off — both preview cards drop the segment immediately. |
| See what each finished operation cost | Keep the `use` switch on; every 「已完成…」 row gets its own number. |
| Make big numbers readable | Leave units on auto, or lock K / M / G / T for a site in its gear menu. |
| Restyle one site | Gear → font size / color / unit. `0` and "follow theme" mean no override. |
| Check before saving | Gear edits reflect in the preview cards right away; the chat badge only changes when you press save. |

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Usage：- **Three configuration entries**: **设置 → Token 计数器** (an own entry in the Settings navigation), the configuration section on this bundle's page in the **插件 / Plugins** panel, and the "Token 计数器" card in that panel's **官方 / Official** group. All three open the same form.
- **Unsaved drafts never leak**: preview and gear edits are staged inside the form; the live badge renders only saved configuration; "save" writes the host config, "discard" reverts everything at once.
- **Fixed units still promote stepwise**: locking `K` on an extreme number never prints `1000K`; it keeps promoting upward (capped at `1000T`).
- **Reasoning text is not a separate figure**: it is part of the provider's `outputTokens` (the platform validates `reasoningTokens <= outputTokens`), so it simply counts toward `out` while streaming. Adding a separate `think` term on top of `out` would double-count, which is why the badge prints no thinking breakdown any more.
- **Reduced motion**: with the system "reduce motion" preference, the sweep decoration is dropped and the numbers stay visible.

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · How it works：- The browser half subscribes to the DSH client `sessions` service and the active (main-view) session's `binding.eventSource`.
- It counts `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` stream chunks as they arrive (both feed the one output total), takes the input count from the authoritative usage first (`inputTokens` + `cacheReadTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens`, i.e. the complete prompt) and from the harness's `contextPressure` projection otherwise, and records authoritative `usage` per step from the `usage` chunk / `assistant/message` event (keyed by turn + step), ignoring its `reasoningTokens` field.
- It injects a DOM badge into the running indicator (there is no slot around it), rebuilt as two counter-moving layers mirroring the platform TextShimmer so the glyphs stay still while the highlight travels. Each completed operation row is one step, so rows walked in document order claim the next settled step of their turn.
- The host half declares the options schema with schemastery (15 fields); the settings form reads and writes the same namespace through `configForms`.

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Package layout：- `lib/index.js` — host half: schemastery `Config` + `apply`.
- `lib/client.js` — browser half via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — registers the plugin profile entry.
- `package.json` — `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client = { platform: "web", inject: [...] }`.

```

dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go README · Feedback & contribution：Issues and suggestions are welcome on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RevxZxCx/dsh-where-did-my-tokens-go/issues) — please include your DSH and plugin versions and steps to reproduce; full screenshots help for UI problems. If the settings form reports "This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now", the host half is not mounted — run `dsh --profile desktop --dump-config` (or check the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`) before filing an issue.
